svg.aria-label: Now building Nolos, A programming language where a lost transaction won’t compile. Money is not a float: 5000 XAF is a token the compiler understands. Write 5000.5 XAF and it refuses: XAF has no decimals. Unknown is part of the language: Every payment call must handle Committed, Aborted and Unknown. Every hold is a finite automaton: Reserved money must end posted, voided or escalated, on every path. λ-Nolos, a formal calculus: Proof sketches: money is never created or lost, and a crash never sends a payment twice. Milestones M0 to M2 are done. Next, M3: The type checker, and the first TypeScript generated from a Nolos flow.
